name: @mm/rules-magic
description: Grid legality, node prerequisites, dormancy, knowledge instances, and tradition hooks — the behaviour behind contracts.md §1.5, §2.2–§2.5 and §3.
author: Ann Kelner
//: Rules-path code: no third-party runtime dependencies, no Node built-ins, integer-only. Per contracts.md §5 it may import sim-core, content, state and primitives — and MUST NOT import rules-world or agent-api. @mm/content is declared but imported for TYPES ONLY, following @mm/primitives: content's public surface re-exports a filesystem-reading loader, and this package builds under `types: []` so that it runs unchanged in a browser. Content facts arrive as a caller-supplied registry.
